chapter_seo_title: Chapter 260: Soul Bewitchment Exposed – Han Li Breaks the Spell
chapter_meta_description: A mysterious male cultivator uses forbidden soul-bewitchment on Dong Xuan’er. Han Li exposes his art and forces him to flee—but the real horror is yet to come.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality – Ch. 260
og_description: Han Li uncovers a master of mind control and teaches the spoiled enchantress a lesson in fear.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 260: The Man Who Owned a Cultivator’s Soul
twitter_description: Dong Xuan’er meets her match: a beautiful man with a soul-bending spell. Han Li breaks the trance with a single word.

lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden magical technique that seizes control of a victim's mind and will, reducing them to an obedient thrall. It is considered a grave violation of autonomy in the cultivation world and is often associated with demonic or heterodox paths.

A private, mana-based communication technique that allows a cultivator to speak directly into another's ear without others hearing. It can bypass physical barriers and is often used for tactical or covert communication.
Another term for an invasive mind-control technique that creates an artificial obsession or devotion in the target, overriding their original personality and will.
A pair of magical cymbal-shaped artifacts known for their sonic attack capabilities; can produce disorienting or damaging sound waves.

A cultivation technique that enhances the user’s innate physical and spiritual allure to cloud the judgment of others; in this context, it is presented as a natural, cultivated form of seduction rather than invasive mind control.
